viewing_check: Check species: Huon pine has a sweet pungent smell when scratched, very fine even grain, pale yellow; celery top or other pine is coarser and scentless. Check thickness, true width and length, splits and checks, and bark inclusions, as these drive price. Huon-confirmed wide, thick slabs reach $140 to $170 hammer; ordinary ones sell $45 to $70.
